patches.name: Disable Beeline telemetry
patches.description:
Stops Beeline from sending usage and crash telemetry to remote servers.

Disables:
- Segment Analytics (track / screen / identify events)
- Firebase Analytics (logEvent)
- Firebase Crashlytics (log messages, recorded exceptions)
- Mapbox map telemetry (events collection switched off at the SDK level)

Does not affect app functionality — only telemetry collection is
suppressed. Navigation, routing, maps and Plus features all keep working.

patches.name: Unlock Beeline Plus features
patches.description:
Unlocks Beeline plus features such as round-trip generation, live traffic and premium map types.
    The following patches are also needed for this patch to work:
        - Fix Firebase after re-signing (rushiranpise/morphe-patches)
        - Provide Original app certificate (rushiranpise/morphe-patches)
        - Spoof app signature (rushiranpise/morphe-patches)
        - Spoof install source (rushiranpise/morphe-patches)
